submission.verdict_reason: IR-62-HOLDOUT-01: the promotion gate is invalid. Across 10 ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED artifacts scored on one identical frozen holdout, HOLDOUT-DTI is ANTI-correlated with the organizer's score (Spearman -0.9141, p=0.00021; partial Spearman controlling for dot count -0.681, p=0.03017; 7 of 8 count-matched pairs go the same way). The standing instruction is not to spend a slot on an idea that has not beaten the current holdout best; the shipped artifact scores 0.0000 against a best of 0.13215463311922815, and no valid instrument exists to overrule that. IR-62-UNIQ-01: the uniqueness rule says DUPLICATE and this repository will not overrule its own tasking protocol autonomously. The literal leg fires against 64 comparators; calibrating it with two nulls waives all but 2 distinct fields, and those bind only marginally (their habitat nulls sit within 0.0282 of the 0.70 waiver cliff, and which of them binds flips with the null seed). Meanwhile every statistic that can actually detect COPYING is far inside its limit: max Jaccard 0.02532 (limit 0.5), max signed rho 0.0647 (limit 0.9), max mutual containment 0.3195. is_a_copy = False. So the honest reading is that the artifact is NOT a copy and the overlap leg is mis-specified for a lane-conformant artifact -- but that is a human judgement to make, not an autonomous one.

band_descriptions: Magnetic anomaly - deviation from expected Earth's magnetic field
Reduced to pole magnetic data - magnetic anomaly corrected for latitude effects
Total magnetic intensity horizontal gradient - rate of change in horizontal direction
Geodetic second invariant - measure of strain rate tensor magnitude
Isostatic gravity anomaly slope - gradient of gravity after isostatic correction
Tilt angle or total curvature - magnetic field derivative for edge detection
Geodetic shear rate - rate of angular deformation from GPS/InSAR
Geodetic dilatation rate - rate of volumetric strain (expansion/contraction)
Total magnetic intensity vertical gradient - rate of change in vertical direction
Distance to earthquake (n=100km radius, a=15° azimuth parameters)
Isostatic gravity anomaly vertical gradient - vertical rate of change
Detrended elevation - topography with regional trends removed
Isostatic gravity anomaly - gravity after compensating for topographic mass
Total magnetic intensity - total strength of magnetic field
Depth to basement surface - thickness of sedimentary cover
Earthquake intensity or density (n=100km radius, a=15° parameters)
Conductivity surface - electrical conductivity of subsurface
Isostatic gravity anomaly horizontal gradient - horizontal rate of change
Detrended elevation slope - gradient of elevation after detrending
